verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents automatic card charging for recurring transactions and automated payment reminders. Neither is an automatic retry of failed payments on an optimized cadence, and nothing in the evidence covers retry logic, smart scheduling, or measured churn recovery. Since dunning applies to a recurring-billing invoicing product, the lack of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn
